## Verified contents

| File | Size | Grid | Tile |
|---|---|---|---|
| `future_city_27.png` | 256×272 | 16 cols × 17 rows | 16×16 |
| `future_city_27_gritty.png` | 256×272 | 16 cols × 17 rows | 16×16 |
| `alley-tiles.png` | 96×96 | 6×6 | 16×16 |
| `characters_24.png` | 32×28 | 2 cols × 2 rows | 16×14 |
| `cars_3.png` | 74×14 | not grid-aligned | — |

These are **facade panels**, not a top-down tilemap: each 16×16 tile is a slice of a
building exterior (lit windows, neon signs reading BAR / SHOP / HOTEL). `characters_24.png`
and `cars_3.png` are not on the 16×16 grid and must not be loaded with
`load_tilesheet`.
